mapper.update: UPDATE sys_import_task SET status = #{status}, error_message = #{message}, end_time = NOW(), duration_ms = CASE WHEN start_time IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, start_time, NOW()) DIV 1000 END, update_time = NOW() WHERE AND status = #{previous}

UPDATE sys_import_task SET status = 'VALIDATING', valid_rows = 0, invalid_rows = 0, error_message = NULL, start_time = NOW(), end_time = NULL, duration_ms = NULL, job_log_id = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE AND status IN ('UPLOADED', 'FAILED', 'VALIDATED') AND success_rows = 0 AND fail_rows = 0 AND file_url != 'PENDING'

UPDATE sys_import_task SET status = 'IMPORTING', error_message = NULL, start_time = NOW(), end_time = NULL, duration_ms = NULL, job_log_id = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE AND status IN ('VALIDATED', 'FAILED') AND valid_rows + invalid_rows = total_rows AND file_url != 'PENDING'
UPDATE sys_import_task SET error_file_url = #{reference}file_url = #{reference}, update_time = NOW() WHERE
UPDATE sys_import_task SET job_log_id = #{jobLogId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE AND status IN ('VALIDATING', 'IMPORTING') AND job_log_id IS NULL

UPDATE sys_import_task SET valid_rows = valid_rows + #{valid}, invalid_rows = invalid_rows + #{invalid}, update_time = NOW() WHERE AND status = 'VALIDATING' AND valid_rows + invalid_rows = #{expected}
UPDATE sys_import_task SET success_rows = success_rows + #{success}, fail_rows = fail_rows + #{failure}, update_time = NOW() WHERE AND status = 'IMPORTING' AND success_rows + fail_rows = #{expected}

SELECT DISTINCT error.row_no FROM sys_import_error error INNER JOIN sys_import_task task ON task.task_id = error.task_id AND task.tenant_id = error.tenant_id WHERE ORDER BY error.row_no

SELECT error.* FROM sys_import_error error INNER JOIN sys_import_task task ON task.task_id = error.task_id AND task.tenant_id = error.tenant_id WHERE AND error.row_no BETWEEN #{firstRow} AND #{lastRow} ORDER BY error.row_no, error.error_id
